name: vyapar-desk
description: Vyapar Desk — distributor business management, packaged for Android with Capacitor

scripts.add:android: cap add android && npm run config:android
scripts.build:debug: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:bundle: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
